source: service.archief.nl (Nationaal Archief, Den Haag), toegang 3.01.14 (Archief van Johan van Oldenbarnevelt, 1586-1619), invnr 2442
unittitle: Missive van Don Juan Gara de Senisteros aan Juan de la Pena van 23 december 1605; afschrift (begin 17e eeuw).
note: invnr 2442 has 11 scans total; per job brief cap ('at most 8'), only scans 1-8 (order field) were fetched at full size. Scans are not all the same physical letter: order 1-2 and order 6 carry the Senisteros-Pena cipher passages (folios numbered 54, 55-56 in the corner stamp); order 3 (folio 84) and order 8 are plain, uncoded Spanish prose from a different item in the same bundle; order 4-5 and order 7 (folios ~40, ~62) carry heavy cipher in what looks like yet another item in the same convolute (old foliation is not sequential with the target letter, so invnr 2442 is a bound file of several separately-foliated copied letters, not one single letter -- consistent with the unittitle describing only one entry drawn from a multi-item file). | 8 Oct 2026 (OLD-SIBS): scans 9-11 fetched; all 11 scans are one letter (folios 54-64, one hand, signed Senisteros on scan 11); see NOTES section 22.
